# Sara Hidalgo · Front-End Developer

> Sara Hidalgo Caro is a front-end web developer from Seville, Spain. She builds fast, accessible websites with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and PHP, uses Astro and Next.js, and is learning React. Background in IT support and quality control for Airbus. Open to front-end roles. She also runs sahica (https://sahica.com), building websites for small local businesses in Seville.

## Featured projects
- [Los Jipis](https://losjipis.com): the history, sources and video of each of the 106 towns in the province of Seville. Astro, Markdown, SEO, accessibility.
- [ConquistaSevilla](https://conquistasevilla.com): free web game to mark the towns of Seville you have visited, with accounts, levels and trophies. PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, OpenStreetMap.
- [sahica](https://sahica.com): her web agency for small businesses in Seville. Astro, PHP, SEO.
- [Reformas 10 de Abril](https://reformas.sahica.com): four-page website for a renovation company in Seville. Astro, SEO, animations.
- [Licencias Una Vez](https://licenciasunavez.sahica.com): directory of software you pay for once instead of a subscription.
- [AtmosferaDev](https://atmosferadev.sahica.com): social network for developers in Spain. Next.js, TypeScript, GitHub API.

## Demo sites
- [All demos](https://portfolio.sahica.com/proyectos/): pizzeria, DJ, photographer, film studio, IT consultancy and more.
